title: Batteries: producer registration required
summary: A producer making batteries available on the market of a member state, including batteries incorporated into products, must be registered in that member state before doing so. Flagged in v1; the full module is v2.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 concerning batteries and waste batteries
sources.note: Fetched the consolidated text directly. TWO FIXES from the 13 Sept draft. (1) Citation: Art. 56 is 'Extended Producer Responsibility' generally (financing, and its own para. 3 -- an authorised-representative duty for cross-border distance sellers under Art. 3(1)(47)(d), same shape as D-040/D-041's pattern but out of scope for this v1 flag row); the registration duty this row actually models is Art. 55 ('Register of producers'), one article earlier. (2) Date bug: Art. 96 (application) states 'Chapter VIII shall apply from 18 August 2025' -- Chapter VIII is Articles 54-63, which includes Art. 55. The draft's effective_from was 2024-08-18, a full year early; a SKU could have been wrongly flagged as needing this registration for a year before the duty actually existed. Corrected to 2025-08-18. NOT modelled, deliberately (per this row's own 'full module is v2' scope): Art. 56(3)'s authorised-representative duty for a producer under Art. 3(1)(47)(d) (a distance seller selling directly to end users in a Member State where it isn't established) -- same shape as the PPWR/AT/ES authorised-representative rows already published.
